text:
ashley: hey team, opened PR #4923 that tweaks the Console latency dashboard and adds a tracehook label on spans. can someone take a quick look? would like to merge before end of week if nothing blocks

mike: looking now — quick question: does the new panel change any saved queries or just the UI?

ashley: only the UI + a small query tweak to include span.label:hooked. no saved query ids changed.

devon: fyi CI is flaking on the metrics unit test on linux runners, seen twice this morning. might block merge if it keeps failing.

ashley: ugh, saw that too. here's the failing snippet from the run:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 12, got 11
tests/test_metrics.py::test_aggregate_latency[linux] FAILED
...
```

sanjay: CI-bot shows network timeout against the prometheus mock in the flaky runs. looks like a parallelization race.

mike: if it's just the mock, we could mark the specific test as xfail on linux for this PR and follow up with a proper fix. acceptable?

devon: prefer to avoid xfail unless we're about to hit a release. what's the merge window?

ashley: no hard release this week, just want it in before a demo next Tues. can do xfail + ticket to fix the mock if team agrees.

mike: ok from me. i'll approve once tests are green or xfail added.

sanjay: also suggest adding a short canary rollout plan for the tracehook label — flag it for 5% traffic first so dashboards don't spike unexpectedly.

ashley: good call. i'll add a feature flag and a note in the PR description about 5% canary, plus updated rollout steps.

ci-bot: re-run requested by mike — build queued (#4923)

ops-bot: reminder — please include an alert tweak if you're changing latency thresholds (pager duty recipients unchanged).

ashley: added PR comment with canary steps, temporary xfail for linux runner, and an issue filed: METRICS-1287 to un-xfail and harden the prometheus mock. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/METRICS-1287

mike: great. approving after green run or after you add the xfail.

devon: leaving a tiny nit about the panel legend but can post it as a follow-up PR — not blocking.

ashley: thanks all — i'll push the xfail change and ping again. planning to merge after a successful re-run or manual override from eng leads if CI is flaky longer than ~3 runs. :thumbsup:
